question: where did attendance percentage decline the most year on year - average the monthly rates per centre and show the decline in percentage points as a positive figure
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) , by_year AS (SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre) SELECT centre, avg_2023 - avg_2024 AS drop_pp FROM by_year ORDER BY drop_pp DESC, centre LIMIT 1

where did attendance percentage decline the most year on year - average the monthly rates per centre and show the decline in percentage points as a positive figure
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH monthly_rates_2023 AS (
    SELECT 
        "Centre",
        "Month",
        ("Avg Daily Present" * 100.0) / NULLIF("Enrolled Kids", 0) AS rate
    FROM "attendance_2023"
),
monthly_rates_2024 AS (
    SELECT 
        "centre_name" AS "Centre",
        "month" AS "Month",
        ("average_attendance" * 100.0) / NULLIF("enrolment", 0) AS rate
    FROM "attendance_2024"
),
avg_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        c23."Centre",
        AVG(c23.rate) AS avg_rate_2023,
        AVG(c24.rate) AS avg_rate_2024
    FROM monthly_rates_2023 c23
    JOIN monthly_rates_2024 c24 
        ON c23."Centre" = c24."Centre" 
        AND c23."Month" = c24."Month"
    GROUP BY c23."Centre"
)
SELECT 
    "Centre",
    (avg_rate_2023 - avg_rate_2024) AS decline_percentage_points
FROM avg_rates
ORDER BY decline_percentage_points DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
